evidence.detail: Exact v308 constructs rs/l/b only from LoginScreen and stores it as the login screen background animation object.
LoginScreen constructs the class from /assets/bg and /assets/bg 2 with displacement magnitude 6, then invokes it from the login-screen draw path every frame.

The animator always draws the base sprite, randomly starts a secondary-sprite horizontal displacement cycle, steps the offset every 45 ms to the configured magnitude, then returns toward zero before idling again.

proposals.note: Descriptive semantic recovery from exact-v308 LoginScreen ownership and background displacement animation; original stripped source identifier is not claimed.
